title: IntelliBot session action envelope, v1
description: Every control-plane action crosses the game link in this envelope. Unknown fields, unknown actions, stale sequence numbers, expired envelopes, and future protocol versions are all rejected fail-closed. Design contract only; no transport is implemented yet.

protocolVersion.description: Envelope version. Receivers reject any version they do not implement.

requestId.description: Unique per request; duplicate requestIds are rejected (replay guard).

sessionId.description: Issued by the host side at session open; dies with the play session.

botHandle.description: Opaque handle for one spawned operator pawn. Never a raw GameObject id, never a player slot, never resolvable to a human player.

seq.description: Monotonic per session. Equal-or-lower than last accepted is rejected (E_STALE_SEQ).

expectedStateVersion.description: Optimistic concurrency: the state version the sender believes current. Mismatch is rejected (E_WRONG_STATE_VERSION).

expiresUtc.description: Envelope is dead after this instant (E_EXPIRED).

action.description: v1 tool surface. Everything not listed is excluded by contract; see contracts/tool-surface-v1.md.

args.description: Bounded action arguments. Every field is optional and only read by the action that defines it.

operatorId.description: operator.spawn only. One operator per handle.

moveTarget.description: move.bounded only. World units, clamped to the play-space envelope.

memoryKey.description: memory.* only. Key namespace is flat and validated; never a file path.
